SELECT ID AS STOCK_ID ,SYMBOL ,NAME ,MARKET FROM T_STOCK WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_DAY IS NULL AND USE_YN = 'Y'
AND ( NAME ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR SYMBOL = #{query} )
AND FEATURED_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY (UPPER(NAME) = UPPER(COALESCE(#{query}, ''))) DESC ,(FEATURED_YN = 'Y') DESC ,LAST_CLOSE * SHARES_OUTSTANDING DESC NULLS LAST ,ID LIMIT 20

SELECT P.TRADE_DATE ,P.OPEN_PRICE ,P.HIGH_PRICE ,P.LOW_PRICE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE ,P.VOLUME FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = P.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND S.SYMBOL = #{symbol} ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC LIMIT #{days}

WITH RANKED AS ( SELECT P.STOCK_ID ,P.TRADE_DATE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.STOCK_ID ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P WHERE 1=1 AND P.TRADE_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} * 2 + 14) ), RESULT AS ( SELECT S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,B.TRADE_DATE AS START_DATE ,B.CLOSE_PRICE AS START_PRICE ,E.TRADE_DATE AS END_DATE ,E.CLOSE_PRICE AS END_PRICE ,ROUND((E.CLOSE_PRICE - B.CLOSE_PRICE) / B.CLOSE_PRICE * 100, 2) AS RETURN_RATE FROM RANKED E JOIN RANKED B ON B.STOCK_ID = E.STOCK_ID AND B.RN = #{days} + 1 JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = E.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND E.RN = 1 AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND S.SECURITY_TYPE = 'STOCK' ) SELECT * FROM ( (SELECT * FROM RESULT ORDER BY RETURN_RATE DESC LIMIT 15) UNION (SELECT * FROM RESULT ORDER BY RETURN_RATE ASC LIMIT 15) ) X ORDER BY RETURN_RATE DESC
